sources: https://www.campspot.com/book/sunken-lake-park (Campspot park record, site types and prices as cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13; Campspot refuses plain HTTP)

values.note: Campspot, one night for 2 adults, June 2027 (Tuesday and Saturday alike): drive-in Primitive Site (offered to motorhomes, to 40 ft) $30, 30/50-amp RV and pull-through sites $35, 30/50-amp waterfront sites $40; walk-in primitive tent sites and a pavilion also sold. Plus the park's $5 'Booking Fee' once per stay. One rate for everyone: the county's Alpena County resident discount ($100) applies to seasonal sites only.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/sunken-lake-park (one-night prices for 2027-06-08 and 2027-06-12: Primitive Site base $30, 30/50 Amp Waterfront RV Site base $40, list $40 incl. $5 fee for the 30/50 Amp RV and Pull-Through sites; 'Booking Fee' $5 per stay; cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13) + https://www.alpenacounty.org/292/Parks-Recreation ('The $100.00 discount given to Alpena County residents is for the seasonal rate only'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Campspot sells 45 drive-in sites by the night (23 30/50-amp with water, 12 30/50-amp waterfront, 3 30/50-amp pull-through, 7 primitive) plus 3 walk-in primitive tent sites; site types listed to 35-40 ft. The county also rents seasonal sites.

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/sunken-lake-park (site types with counts and max lengths: 30/50 Amp RV Site 23 / 40 ft, 30/50 Amp Waterfront RV Site 12 / 40 ft, 30/50 Amp Pull-Through RV Site 3 / 35 ft, Primitive Site 7 / 40 ft; cached in audit/price_research/campspot_tier_2026-10-13.jsonl, read 2026-10-13) + https://www.alpenacounty.org/292/Parks-Recreation (seasonal reservations), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.alpenacounty.org/292/Parks-Recreation ('The camping season is from May 15 until October 15 annually') + Campspot park record (closed from 2026-10-15 to 2027-05-14, so the last night is October 14), read 2026-10-22 / 2026-10-13

values.note: Book online on Campspot or call the park, 989-379-3055. Reservations open after January 2 for that year's season; one night's deposit, two nights' over holiday weekends. Weekly, monthly and seasonal rentals too. No refunds: deposits can be applied to a stay within a year.

booking.source: https://www.alpenacounty.org/292/Parks-Recreation ('Reservations are accepted after January 2 each year and require a deposit of one (1) night's stay ... Holiday weekends require a deposit of two (2) night's stay'; 'Alpena County has a no refund policy'; Sunken Lake Park 989-379-3055, 'Online Reservations' -> https://www.campspot.com/book/sunken-lake-park), read 2026-10-22

summary: Confirmed on the county pages and the county's Campspot engine: $30 (drive-in primitive, offered to motorhomes) to $40 (waterfront) with a $5 per-stay booking fee, 50-amp/water, May 15 - Oct 14 season, reservable on Campspot. Added max 40 ft, pull-throughs, booking details. Stored site count (55) left: Campspot sells 45 drive-in + 3 walk-in sites by the night and the county also rents seasonals. No nightly resident/non-resident split (the county's resident discount is for seasonal sites only). Showers/dump left as is (the county page says only 'modern camping sites').
